```{python}
#| label: missing-v2-setup
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from expanded_results import *
clinical = clinical_metrics("missing_leads_v2")
coverage = clinical_coverage("missing_leads_v2")
```

## Why `missing_leads_v2` is canonical

This evaluation scores reconstructed missing leads against the measured
12-lead ECG and prevents observed-lead passthrough from inflating performance.
Rows from `legacy_v1` are not pooled with it. The reference rows describe the
measured-signal benchmark; they are not trained reconstruction models.

## Coverage audit before interpretation

```{python}
#| label: missing-v2-coverage
display(coverage.style.format({"coverage_pct": "{:.1f}%", "clinical_coverage_pct": "{:.1f}%"}))
long = coverage.melt(id_vars="architecture", value_vars=["registered", "clinical_models"],
                     var_name="stage", value_name="models")
fig = px.bar(long, x="architecture", y="models", color="stage", barmode="group",
             text="models", range_y=[0, 168],
             title="Checkpoint availability is not clinical-evaluation availability")
fig.add_hline(y=160, line_dash="dash")
fig.show()
```

The database currently contains all 160 U-Net models, 37 MSVAE models, and no
ECG-AIM models under `missing_leads_v2`. Therefore:

- U-Net supports a complete within-architecture clinical factorial analysis.
- MSVAE supports only explicitly labeled partial/descriptive analysis.
- ECG-AIM has **no clinical result in this database**; it is missing evidence,
  not a negative outcome.
- Cross-architecture clinical rankings are blocked by differential coverage.

## Endpoint and dataset inventory

```{python}
#| label: missing-v2-inventory
inventory = (clinical.groupby(["architecture", "dataset"], dropna=False)
             .agg(models=("model_id", "nunique"), endpoints=("target", "nunique"), rows=("model_id", "size"))
             .reset_index())
display(inventory)
```

Model rows currently occur on PTB-XL; the external dataset rows are reference
standards only. Claims of external model preservation require actual model rows,
not the presence of a reference cohort in the same database.

## Modular endpoint explorer

```{python}
#| label: missing-v2-endpoint-explorer
MODEL_FAMILY = "unet"       # change to msvae only with partial-coverage caveat
METRIC = "auroc"            # try mae, pearson_r, r2, auprc, f1, sens, spec
TOP_N = 20
view = clinical.query("architecture == @MODEL_FAMILY").copy()
if not view.empty and METRIC in view:
    usable = view.dropna(subset=[METRIC])
    direction = usable.nlargest if METRIC not in {"mae"} else usable.nsmallest
    selected = direction(TOP_N, METRIC)
    fig = px.scatter(selected, x="target", y=METRIC, color="mask", hover_name="model_id",
                     title=f"{MODEL_FAMILY}: selected {METRIC} rows (coverage-aware explorer)")
    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=55)
    fig.show()
    display(selected[["model_id", "mask", "dataset", "target", METRIC]])
```

The explorer is deliberately not a composite clinical score. AUROC, calibration,
amplitude error, interval timing, and variance retention answer different
questions and can disagree.

## PreSACan and paired-inference coverage

The granular PreSACan tables currently cover 160 U-Nets only. Paired inference
covers 160 U-Nets and 37 MSVAEs. These tables should be interpreted within their
own coverage envelope; they cannot fill the ECG-AIM gap.
